title: Implementation Plan for Futuristic Cyber Audio Visualizer

steps.description: Initialize the HTML structure and include necessary dependencies (Three.js and Web Audio API) for the visualizer.
steps.testCriteria: HTML page loads with a full-screen canvas element and Three.js library is successfully imported.

steps.description: Implement the Web Audio API logic to initialize the AudioContext and AnalyserNode for real-time signal processing.
steps.testCriteria: AnalyserNode successfully captures frequency data from a sample audio source.

steps.description: Set up the Three.js scene, camera, and renderer to establish the 3D environment.
steps.testCriteria: Three.js scene renders a basic 3D object in the viewport.

steps.description: Develop the custom GLSL shader pipeline and map AnalyserNode data to shader uniforms.
steps.testCriteria: Shader uniforms update every frame based on the AnalyserNode's output.

steps.description: Implement the main animation loop to synchronize the audio data processing with the Three.js render loop.
steps.testCriteria: Visual elements (neon glows, glitch effects) react dynamically to audio input in real-time.

verificationGateChecklist: AST code health clean (no empty catch, no any)
